token.label: API Access Token
token.description: Enter your Wealthbox API access token. Get it from Settings → API Access Tokens in your Wealthbox account.

create_contact.label: Create Contact
create_contact.description: Adds a new contact with rich details (name, address, email, tags, etc.)

first_name.label: First Name
first_name.description: The first name of the contact

last_name.label: Last Name
last_name.description: The last name of the contact

prefix.label: Prefix
prefix.description: The preferred prefix for the contact (e.g., Mr., Ms., Dr.)

middle_name.label: Middle Name
middle_name.description: The middle name of the contact

suffix.label: Suffix
suffix.description: The suffix associated with the contact (e.g., Jr., Sr., M.D.)

nickname.label: Nickname
nickname.description: A preferred shortname for the contact

job_title.label: Job Title
job_title.description: The title the contact holds at their present company

company_name.label: Company Name
company_name.description: The name of the contact's present company

type.label: Contact Type
type.description: The type of the contact being created

contact_type.label: Contact Classification
contact_type.description: A string further classifying the contact

status.label: Status
status.description: Whether the contact is currently active

birth_date.label: Birth Date
birth_date.description: The birthdate of the contact (YYYY-MM-DD format)

marital_status.label: Marital Status
marital_status.description: The marital status of the contact

email_address.label: Email Address
email_address.description: Primary email address for the contact

phone_number.label: Phone Number
phone_number.description: Primary phone number for the contact (e.g., (555) 123-4567)

street_line_2.label: Street Address Line 2
street_line_2.description: Second line of street address (apt, suite, etc.)

state.label: State
state.description: State or province for the address

zip_code.label: ZIP Code
zip_code.description: ZIP or postal code for the address

twitter_name.label: Twitter Handle
twitter_name.description: The twitter handle of the contact

linkedin_url.label: LinkedIn URL
linkedin_url.description: The LinkedIn URL for the contact

background_information.label: Background Information
background_information.description: A brief description of the contact

important_information.label: Important Information
important_information.description: Any other important info for the contact

contact_source.label: Contact Source
contact_source.description: The method in which this contact was acquired

tags.label: Tags
tags.description: Tags to associate with the contact (e.g., "Client", "VIP", "Referral")

external_unique_id.label: External Unique ID
external_unique_id.description: A unique identifier for this contact in an external system

create_project.label: Create Project
create_project.description: Starts a new project with description and organizer. Launch project-based onboarding when new clients sign up.

name.label: Project Name
name.description: The name of the project (e.g., "Client Onboarding", "Q1 Review Process")

description.label: Project Description
description.description: A detailed explanation of the project goals and scope

organizer.label: Organizer
organizer.description: Select the user who will be responsible for organizing this project

visible_to.label: Visible To
visible_to.description: Select who can view this project

create_household.label: Create Household
create_household.description: Creates a household record with emails, tags. Group family member contacts into one household.

name.label: Household Name
name.description: The name of the household (e.g., "The Anderson Family", "Smith Household")

head_contact_id.label: Head of Household
head_contact_id.description: Select the contact who will be the head of this household

spouse_contact_id.label: Spouse/Partner (Optional)
spouse_contact_id.description: Select the spouse or partner to automatically add to this household

email_address.label: Primary Email Address
email_address.description: Primary email address for the household

street_line_2.label: Street Address Line 2
street_line_2.description: Second line of street address (apt, suite, etc.)

state.label: State
state.description: State or province for the household address

zip_code.label: ZIP Code
zip_code.description: ZIP or postal code for the household address

phone_number.label: Primary Phone Number
phone_number.description: Primary phone number for the household

type.label: Household Type
type.description: The type of household being created

status.label: Status
status.description: Whether the household is currently active

important_information.label: Important Information
important_information.description: Any important information about the household

visible_to.label: Visible To
visible_to.description: Select who can view this household

external_unique_id.label: External Unique ID
external_unique_id.description: A unique identifier for this household in an external system

create_task.label: Create Task
create_task.description: Creates tasks tied to contacts with due dates and assignment types. Assign follow-up actions when opportunities are created.

name.label: Task Name
name.description: The name of the task (e.g., "Return Bill's call", "Follow up on proposal")

assigned_to.label: Assigned To
assigned_to.description: Select the user who the task is assigned to

description.label: Description
description.description: A detailed explanation of the task

priority.label: Priority
priority.description: The priority level of the task

complete.label: Mark as Complete
complete.description: Check if the task should be created as already completed

link_type.label: Link To
link_type.description: What type of record to link this task to

category.label: Category
category.description: Select the category this task belongs to

visible_to.label: Visible To
visible_to.description: Select who can view this task

due_later.label: Due Later
due_later.description: Interval for when this task is due after start (e.g., "2 days later at 5:00 PM")
